- Confirmed 64 oral papers exist at `https://iccv.thecvf.com/virtual/2025/events/oral`
- Attempted to scrape individual paper pages for titles, authors, and affiliations using curl and Python (BeautifulSoup)
- Initial scraping attempts failed to extract author/affiliation data due to dynamic/JavaScript-rendered content on CVF pages
- Tried alternative sources: papers.cool (truncated), GitHub repo (limited info), papercopilot.com (stats only, no detailed list)
- Multiple grep/curl attempts to find author/affiliation patterns in HTML were unsuccessful

## Context for Suffix
- The assistant is stuck trying to extract author and affiliation information from CVF's dynamically loaded pages
- Has a list of 64 oral paper URLs but cannot easily parse author/affiliation data from static HTML
- May need to try alternative approaches: browser automation, different data sources (OpenAccess PDFs, papers.cool with higher maxChars, or searching for individual papers with known SJTU/FDU authors)
